card.name: When in treatment events occur
card.fires_on: Words that start a time phrase right after 'most commonly occurred', 'majority occurred' or 'occurred within', such as 'first', 'during', 'within', or the day number. It marks where a timing of onset is about to be given.

modes.label: Onset timing phrase
modes.description: The word or number opening a time-of-onset phrase after a statement that reactions mostly occurred.
modes.example: IRRs occurred predominantly during the<< first>> infusion of GAZYVA.

modes.label: Within a time span
modes.description: The space after 'within' just before a number of hours or months.
modes.example: many of these cases occurred within<< >>12 hours of dosing.
